head: Wallmix wallpaper and widget app for iPhone: live, 3D and photo widgets
dek: Wallmix is a free iPhone and iPad app with static, dual, 3D and live wallpapers plus Lock Screen widgets you make from your own text and photos. It was #85 in Graphics & Design on the US App Store's free chart on 12 November.
details: You can preview a wallpaper before saving it, cut the background out of a photo and set a widget's size, position and rotation. Ready-made widgets show words with translations, quotes, world capitals and facts. A Pro version adds 20 fonts; the listing gives no price for it. It's made by Timur Smailov, came out on 30 September and needs iOS 18.
where: iPhone and iPad, free, Pro extras
means: If you like changing your Lock Screen, it puts wallpapers and custom widgets in one app.
todo: Preview a wallpaper before you save it, and check what Pro costs inside the app before you pay.
